method: men’s college basketball: Offense and defense points ratings fit to ESPN finals (ridge shrinkage, 90-day half-life, home edge; for basketball the ratings are points per game, so pace is inside them). Game total = both teams’ expected points. No injury data for this sport yet. A total 8+ points from the market with no injury or weather explanation is halved toward the market and marked for review.
